incident_description: Fraud engine flagged a login for customer CUST-3310 from an IP geolocating to Dubai, UAE. Customer's registered country is Bangladesh. MFA passed on first attempt. No transactions made post-login. Customer has an active travel flag for UAE.

API gateway detected API key API-KEY-882 making 620 requests per minute to the /accounts/balance endpoint. The key belongs to a registered partner. Prior incident on record for this key on 2026-10-10 — that incident was a misconfigured retry loop, resolved as false positive.

IT Helpdesk staff member Carlos Mendez (EMP-007) received an email from 'it-security@internal-novapay-it.com' asking him to click a link and enter his Active Directory credentials to 'sync his account with the new security portal.' Carlos did not click but forwarded the email to the SOC.
